Diagnosis.submission: The checkout Deployment in the astronomy-shop namespace was unschedulable and down. Its pod template had an invalid nodeSelector: kubernetes.io/hostname=extra-node, but no node with that hostname exists in the cluster (nodes are kind-control-plane, kind-worker, kind-worker2, kind-worker3). As a result, all checkout pods remained in Pending state, the checkout Deployment was 0/1 available, and the checkout/order-placement path of the Astronomy Shop failed. Root cause: a misconfigured nodeSelector (bad node constraint) on the checkout Deployment. Fix: removed the invalid nodeSelector so checkout pods can schedule on an available node.
